description: Rebuild every page/route on top of the new shell, immersive hero, motion primitives, and rebuilt section components, delivering the modern immersive experience end to end. Compose each of the ten routes (home, about-us, services, projects, contact-us, ai-dev-automation-playbook, ai-dev-automation-playbook-form, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, and the __root shell/meta) into a coherent, well-structured page-by-page experience. Preserve all route head meta (titles, descriptions, canonical, og/twitter), the JSON-LD organization data in __root, and the fully working Supabase-backed contact + playbook forms (contact-form.tsx, playbook-form.tsx) including honeypot + startedAt human-timing fields the server functions expect. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Home (src/routes/index.tsx): rebuild around the immersive 3D hero (ClientCanvas + copy overlay + static fallback), followed by a scroll-driven narrative of MetricsStrip, ProjectsGrid (featured subset), ServicesCards/pinned services, TechnologyBand marquee, IndustryGrid (subset), ValuesGrid, FounderStory, ProcessGrid, FaqSection. Keep the exact head meta and canonical from the current file. Use Reveal/Magnetic throughout; keep the homepage scannable.
About (src/routes/about-us.tsx): rebuild with PageIntro-style immersive header and the story/values/process/founder content, preserving head meta and canonical.

Services (src/routes/services.tsx): rebuild ServicesCards + TechnologyBand + full IndustryGrid within the new motion system, preserving the sr-only h2 heading structure (no h1->h3 jump) and head meta/canonical.
Projects (src/routes/projects.tsx): rebuild the full projects showcase (all 16) using the rebuilt grid/showcase components, preserving head meta/canonical.

Contact (src/routes/contact-us.tsx): rebuild layout but keep the ContactForm component wired to the submitContact server function; the form MUST keep its honeypot `website` field and hidden `startedAt` timestamp so submission-guards' assertHumanTiming/enforceRateLimit still pass. Preserve head meta/canonical.

Playbook (src/routes/ai-dev-automation-playbook.tsx and ai-dev-automation-playbook-form.tsx): rebuild layout but keep PlaybookForm wired to requestPlaybook with its honeypot + startedAt fields intact. Preserve head meta/canonical.
Legal (src/routes/privacy-policy.tsx, terms-of-service.tsx): apply the new shell/typography; content and head meta preserved.

__root (src/routes/__root.tsx): keep the RootShell html/head/body structure, the skip link, the JSON-LD organization script, font preloads, the QueryClientProvider + Outlet + PrivacyAnalytics, and all head meta. Modernize only what is safe; do NOT touch the generated routeTree.gen.ts. If a global smooth-scroll/cursor belongs at the root vs PageLayout, wire it consistently without duplicating providers.
Verify each rebuilt route still renders its section components from site-data.ts and that no route statically imports three (only ClientCanvas does, via dynamic import).
Keep the hero video asset usage (or its fallback role) and ensure the forms' end-to-end contract with forms.functions.ts is unchanged (field names, types).
acceptance_criteria: All ten routes are rebuilt on the new shell + motion system and remain structurally coherent page by page.
Every route preserves its existing head meta (title, description, canonical, og/twitter) and __root preserves JSON-LD org data, font preloads, skip link, providers, and Outlet.
ContactForm and PlaybookForm remain wired to submitContact/requestPlaybook with the honeypot `website` and hidden `startedAt` fields intact, so submission-guards still function.
The home page uses the immersive 3D hero with a working static fallback; interior pages use appropriate lighter headers.
No route or shared layout statically imports three/@react-three/fiber/@react-three/drei (only ClientCanvas via dynamic import).
routeTree.gen.ts and images.ts remain untouched; all content still sourced from site-data.ts.
Code is type-correct and eslint/prettier clean by construction.
verification: Grep all files under src/routes for `from "three"`, `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei` and confirm zero static imports there.
Read contact-us + playbook routes/forms and confirm the honeypot + startedAt fields and server-fn wiring are intact.
Confirm head meta blocks match the pre-rebuild titles/canonicals for each route.
CI typecheck/lint/test/build is the authoritative validator (cannot run in-sandbox).
findings:
ENVIRONMENT (unchanged from FEAT-001/002/003, confirmed not repaired): INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, npm registry unreachable, node_modules has no tool binaries, npm/node broken by a missing NODE_OPTIONS preload. typecheck/lint/test/build CANNOT run in-sandbox; all code written type-correct and eslint/prettier-clean BY CONSTRUCTION (printWidth 100, 2-space, double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas). CI is the authoritative validator. package-lock.json still needs CI/maintainer regeneration (flagged in FEAT-001); left untouched.

STATE ON ARRIVAL: FEAT-003 had already wired ALL ten routes onto the new shell (PageLayout/PageIntro compose SmoothScrollProvider + CustomCursor; the home hero got its ClientCanvas 3D backdrop; the section components in content-sections.tsx already compose Reveal/Magnetic/Marquee). So the bulk of the route rebuild was in place. FEAT-004 verified end-to-end coherence, fixed a compile-breaking regression, and refined route-level composition.

CRITICAL FIX (branch was NOT compiling): src/components/content-sections.tsx shipped from FEAT-003 with a DUPLICATE top import line `import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";` (duplicate-identifier TS2300/redeclare + lint error) AND an unused `Check` in the lucide-react import (no-unused-vars). Both would fail CI typecheck+lint and every route depends on this module. Removed the duplicate import line and dropped `Check` (verified `Check` has zero uses in the file; `ArrowRight`/`ArrowUpRight` remain used). This is the single most important change in the feature; without it the whole branch failed to build.

ROUTE REFINEMENTS (composition, no layout risk):
- index.tsx (home): wrapped the two 'section-action' CTA buttons (View all work -> /projects, See all industries -> /services) in <Magnetic strength={14}>. Magnetic renders an inline-flex wrapper (.immersive-magnetic, FEAT-003 CSS) and self-disables under reduced-motion + coarse/touch pointers, so no layout shift and no regression for the button/asChild Link. Home already had the full immersive narrative (ClientCanvas 3D hero backdrop + HeroVideo perspective card, MetricsStrip, ProjectsGrid limit 4, PinnedServicesShowcase, TechnologyBand, IndustryGrid limit 8, ValuesGrid, FounderStory, ProcessGrid, FaqSection) inside ScrollFocusStack; head meta + canonical (https://www.demazetech.com/) untouched.
- ai-dev-automation-playbook.tsx: wrapped the 'Download guide' CTA in <Magnetic strength={14}>. Head meta/canonical untouched.
- No other route markup needed changes: about-us, services (keeps sr-only h2 'What we build' so heading order stays h1->h2->h3), projects (ProjectsShowcaseGrid renders ALL 16 via the 'All' category default, no limit passed; keeps its sr-only h2 'All projects'), contact-us, ai-dev-automation-playbook-form, privacy-policy, terms-of-service were already correctly composed on PageIntro/PageLayout + section components; their head meta/canonical are preserved verbatim (I did not touch any head() block on any route).

DID NOT wrap the playbook .playbook-cover in <Reveal>: RevealProps does not accept `aria-hidden` (it does not spread rest props), so passing aria-hidden would be a TS error; kept the decorative cover as a plain aria-hidden div.

FORMS CONTRACT INTACT (verified by read): contact-form.tsx and playbook-form.tsx are unchanged — both keep the honeypot `website` field (aria-hidden label + tabIndex -1 Input) and the hidden `startedAt` = useState(() => Date.now()) passed into submitContact/requestPlaybook, so submission-guards' assertHumanTiming + enforceRateLimit still receive the fields the server fns expect. forms.functions.ts and submission-guards.ts were NOT touched.

__root.tsx: reviewed and intentionally left UNCHANGED. RootShell (html/head/HeadContent/body), the skip link (#main-content), the JSON-LD organization <script>, the two woff2 font preloads + stylesheet link, QueryClientProvider + <Outlet /> + <PrivacyAnalytics />, and ALL head meta are already correct and modern. SmoothScrollProvider + CustomCursor live in PageLayout (FEAT-003); adding them at root too would DUPLICATE providers, so they stay only in PageLayout per the briefing. Nothing safe left to modernize without risk.

SSR SAFETY (re-verified): grepped src/routes/*.tsx for `three` / `@react-three/fiber` / `@react-three/drei` — the only match is index.tsx importing <ClientCanvas> from @/components/three/client-canvas (which reaches three ONLY through its gated lazy dynamic import). No route or shared layout statically imports three. `react-three` at module scope appears only in src/components/three/hero-scene.tsx.

UNTOUCHED (verified via git status): src/lib/site-data.ts, src/lib/site-data.test.ts (invariants services 4 / projects >=16 / metrics 4 / technologies 8 / industries >=15 all still hold — no data changed), src/assets/images.ts (generated), src/routeTree.gen.ts (generated), src/lib/forms.functions.ts, src/lib/submission-guards.ts, package.json, package-lock.json. Left the unrelated untracked file .agents/tasks/task-production-audit-fixes/2026-09-10-172633-review.md alone (not staged).

VERIFY IN CI (cannot run in-sandbox): npm run typecheck + lint (the content-sections duplicate-import/unused-import fix is what unblocks these), npm test (vitest), and npm run build (SSR — proves the 3D hero backdrop on / does not crash server render).
